error.code and nonempty error.message are required for errors; reason is absent for ordinary company/app errors, optional only where an entrypoint declares subclassification, exact for outbound retry delivery_uncertain/state_changed. Null reason is not an unresolved protocol blocker.

Refine impossible organize-only state: existing API and PostgreSQL CHECK reject organize without read before it can exist. Shared operation case uses representable read-only grant and expects 403; the original organize-only grant input is separately asserted BAD_REQUEST/400. Policy still requires both rights; no constraint or production behavior is relaxed.
Background SweepCompanyMetadata has no HTTP endpoint. Required evidence is PostgreSQL, not a fabricated HTTP adapter; the semantic protected-prefix/orphan target is unchanged.

Freeze precise current entrypoints: successor frozen before execute400; cross-company or self successor preview400 with no invalid plan fabricated; administrator cannot offboard equal/higher-role target403. higher_role is explicitly target management hierarchy, not a new ban on higher-role successors.

Freeze owned valid-principal expired-content compatibility entrypoints: legacy list/detail and same-key consumed draft replay each return200 safe receipt; canonical content remains404 and replay preserves the same job identity.

Declare actual background DB/reaper evidence rather than inventing HTTP coverage. Both sealed_draft and held_raw are built by production disposition/ingress methods; creation/fixed-destination tombstones and orphan retry registration never grant deletion.

Explicitly model independent logical item expiry versus live durable reference ownership, and use actual metadata/raw reaper DB ports rather than a nonexistent GC HTTP endpoint. Each of draft/sent_asset/queue/held is exercised; expired normal message alone cannot authorize another asset object deletion.

Declare current real schema/response capability observations rather than inventing a backfill command. Exact trusted job BCC missing from durable asset and absent legacy_unknown are precise target gaps. Future idempotent backfill execution remains explicitly unverified.

Use a genuine expired trash purge_after cutoff for normal personal content. Existing permanent personal policy intentionally ignores anomalous hard expires_at; do not reinterpret historical values or turn the fixture failure into target red. Preserve independent durable reference protection target.

Source and repeated actual SQL/runtime evidence identify a real current GetWorkMessage purge-cutoff gap (A05/AC-10/P3-010), not fixture failure. Bind only exact returned provenance beyond confirmed cutoff to dedicated read-boundary marker; continue all independent physical protection assertions and reject unexpected query/fixture errors.

Replace obsolete unresolved status labels with applicable actual entrypoint semantics: background DB ports not_applicable; draft submit201; current content/permission/surface HTTP200; PE05 exact ordered200/403. BC02/03 status only describes current GET capability observation, never a nonexistent future backfill command. Required component and future migration gaps remain explicit.

Freeze actual shipping handler failures at500/INTERNAL with nonempty message, now backed by real SQL/audit fault consumers. Remove obsolete missing-HTTP-binding note; this does not widen accepted statuses.
